work_history.title: Data Advisor - Analytics Engineer (Consultant)
work_history.description: Building a Microsoft Fabric data platform from scratch for an enterprise client - connecting SAP, Salesforce, and SQL Server via Data Factory and Dataflows Gen2 with CDC patterns, landing everything into a governed OneLake lakehouse. Set up a medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) using Spark notebooks and Fabric SQL with data quality checks, schema contracts, and lineage tracking baked in at each layer, not bolted on after. Replaced nightly batch reports with real-time streaming pipelines using Spark Structured Streaming and Fabric Eventstream - records land in Eventhouse KQL…

work_history.title: BI Developer / Analytics Engineer
work_history.description: Migrated a mess of ad hoc SQL scripts and spreadsheet extracts into a proper dbt project on Snowflake standardised models, automated tests, and documentation that actually matched what the data did. Set up Amazon MWAA to replace cron jobs that nobody fully understood - DAGs with retries, proper logging, and enough visibility that the team could tell at a glance what ran and what didn't. Built a predictive maintenance dashboard on real-time IoT data from factory equipment - the kind of thing where a maintenance engineer looks at it in the morning and decides what to check before something…

work_history.title: Sustainability Data Analyst
work_history.description: Built ELT pipelines on GCP using Cloud Composer and Dataflow to pull sustainability data from facilities across the world, turning what was a manual, multi-week reporting exercise into something that refreshed automatically. Replaced full-load nightly extracts with Debezium CDC pipelines - change events flowing continuously from source systems so the downstream dbt models were always working with fresh data. Wrote the dbt models that standardised CO2 calculations across Scope 1, 2, and 3 globally - same logic, same numbers, auditable - which mattered a lot when regulators and third-party…

work_history.title: Supply Chain Data Analyst
work_history.description: Built QlikSense dashboards that gave supply chain managers an up-to-date view of KPIs across product lines - they had been working off weekly Excel exports, so the reaction to live data was fairly dramatic. Did a root cause analysis on lead time delays using Python and BigQuery, traced the bottlenecks back to specific supplier tiers and logistics routes, and gave procurement something concrete to take into negotiations

work_history.title: Market Analyst
work_history.description: Produced market forecasts and competitive analysis reports for industrial clients across Europe, putting together the numbers and the narrative so the people making decisions had what they needed in one place. Built Tableau dashboards so clients could dig into the data themselves between reports, which cut down the stream of one-off data requests considerably

work_history.title: Data Analyst
work_history.description: Pulled together financial data from several different sources, wrote Python outlier detection to catch the kind of data issues that tend to slip through and show up in reports at the worst possible moment. Built Power BI dashboards for senior leadership - monthly and quarterly views that gave them a consistent baseline to work from instead of a different spreadsheet every time someone ran the numbers
